comment: Some writing and two important tests.

Dr. Sznajder-Lee is very knowledgeable and cares a lot about each topic she discusses. Sometimes there is a lot of reading assigned but overall if you participate you will be fine. She gives you no grades back so you won't know your grade until the grades are released which is a bit anxiety-inducing.

Dr. Sznajder-Lee is a funny and caring professor who knows a lot about her field and does a good job at imparting this to her students. Her tests and assignments are pretty easy, if you like the subject, you'll have a lot of fun. She's pretty accommodating, too, and is helpful if you ever have a problem. The only downside is that she grades slowly

Dr. Sznajder-Lee is very nice and very knowledgable about her subject area. She's always quite flexible, but is a pretty slow grader and some instructions are kind of vauge. It's hard to tell exactly how you're doing in the class until the end.

Super funny and caring professor! Take if you like European politics - she is super knowledgable and has lots of relevant personal experiences. Super flexible on deadlines and will provide feedback if you reach out. Only thing is she takes a while to grade during the semester so you won't know your grade until the very end.

Great professor, extremely helpful and flexible with deadlines! Only drawback is she takes a long time to grade assignments so you don't know your grade until the end. Take this class if you have a genuine interest in European politics and the EU.

I received two grades the whole semester. My midterm and one paper (out of four). She is also a bit scattered in her lectures, so it's hard to learn from her. She's big on tangents and can veer into a completely different topic very easily (without ever answering your question or finishing her original point). But she's very nice and accommodating!

This class is very reading heavy, so be prepared to read. Lectures aren't always very structured, so if you are not doing your homeworks, you will be lost. She doesn't grade things quickly, and I still have an assignment from 30th Sep ungraded. This is the most frustrating thing about the class, but overall, really kind and approachable professor.
Not great at lectures, and did not give back papers, so you did not know how to improve. Gave a lot of reading for homework and would send it late the night before class

Dr. Sznajder is very energetic. My only grievance with her is that she does not grade quickly and takes a while to update the gradebook. Course is very heavy on reading, anywhere from 20-60 page required for each class. No in-class tests outside of midterm and final. Accessible outside of class, in person and online, but must tell her beforehand.

She's like nice and all and the material isn't hard but the class is super unengaging and disorganized. There's no clear grading criteria and every lecture is unfocused. Such a boring class and I am not at all sure of its purpose. Felt like a waste of time.
w teach, w teach, w teach

Nice professor but kind of spacey so lectures can get a bit off topic or boring. She likes when people participates, but not a make or break on your grade. Midterm and final are solely based on her study guides so make sure you know them really well. Class lectures are repeats of the textbook chapters so you don't need to read them. Fair grader

A great prof. Not a super difficult class, especially for 300-level PLSC. Funny and allows flexibility in the course to cover what students' interests. She is slow grader, but always willing to meet. Very caring. Take her whenever you get the chance. I'm not particularly interested in European politics but she has made the class great.

Great professor. She is a little everywhere, but I found it to be comforting. Extremely knowledgeable about PLSC and will go on tangents, but they always help to provide context. Just reading the textbook isn't helpful. You have to listen to the examples and how they connect together. She goes over everything in class, so pay attention in class.

She's a bit quirky, extremely caring and receptive to student feedback on how things should be/ could be better. Classes are lecture-heavy but she makes up for it with her clear rubrics, instructions, study guides which are ABSOLUTE life savers, and being understanding in general. Lectures are easy to follow and clear. Would love to take her again!

Great prof. She tends to go on tangents and gets off track during lectures. Lots of textbook readings but will go over everything in class. Assignments have exact grading criteria so it is easy to do well. Exams are not hard.

Bad: Lectures lose focus Good: Everything else, professor is nice and makes the class extremely engaging. A lot of work is required but if you do it she will reward you. Never took a Polsci class before but she is always willing to help students and answer the silly questions. If you need this for a credit or CLAC take her and you wont regret it

Dr. Lee is an incredibly caring and kind professor. She was receptive to students' needs and worked to help students be comfortable. Tests are straightforward and based on her study guides. Lots of low stakes quizzes and writing assignments. One major essay. Dr. Lee was a fair grader. Only critique is that classes often lost focus. Textbook heavy.

Lee is very understanding & lenient in grading. Shows to have so much knowledge & passion about politics yet babbles alot in her lectures which can get dull & lose direction. She enjoys making students get into groups for small in-class assignments. Reading not required but helps. Will answer her own questions if no one participates (happens alot).

Really a great woman who is always very accessible outside of class. Most of the classes are lecture based, and all assignments have very clear rubrics/grading criteria. She's pretty funny and understanding, but be sure to participate and show effort

She really knows her material, so shes the best help you can get, if you need it. She can be a little tough to reach sometimes; shes rescheduled some office hours. Her lectures are basically the textbook reading, so dont even worry.

She is very caring and funny. Her lectures are hard to follow, but if you are patient you will be rewarded because she is passionate and knowledgable about the topic. The class is centered around 3 six page assignments and two midterms.

She's extremely knowledgeable! She does not really offer extra credit, but she does have many opportunities to meet her in her office hours! She sometimes speaks rapidly, and she knows she's giving out a lot of information, so don't be afraid to ask her to repeat a question or rephrase something. If you genuinely follow the rubric, you'll be good.

Extremely smart and funny - she had a way of making a boring class topic manageable. It's definitely hard to do well, but she has very clear criteria and grades with an open mind when it comes to papers. Also one of the most accessible professors on campus, she loves to help her students.

I had her for my senior thesis class. she was so incredibly knowledgeable, helpful and genuinely cares about her students. There is a lot of assigned reading but she will spend the whole class discussing it so you actually understand whats going on. its important to participate in class but its pretty casual. shes funny too. i recommend her class!

She is so sweet !! She is always smiling and is very friendly. I think this was a rough semester for her because we did not know our grades until the last minute. She knows what is she teaching very well but she can get off topic. Because she knows what she is talking about, she talks the whole class and can sometimes go over class time.

Great human being. It was my senior thesis so the class was hard but that is understandable. She has some very funny stories/knows the topic really well but can get off topic sometimes.A lot of reading but it isn't really necessary to do all of it. She also adjusts her syllabus to the pace of the course which is great.
just do the readings and speak up in class and she'll like you a lot
